# upsnap_device_sleep (Action)

Suspend a device through [Sleep-On-LAN](https://github.com/SR-G/sleep-on-lan); requires `sol_enabled` on the device.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. The credentials need `power` permission on the device, or a superuser.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# terraform apply -invoke=action.upsnap_device_sleep.workstation
action "upsnap_device_sleep" "workstation" {
  config {
    device_id = upsnap_device.workstation.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) ID of the device.

### Optional

- `timeout` (String) How long to wait for UpSnap, as a Go duration such as `90s` or `10m`. Defaults to `5m`.
- `wait` (Boolean) Wait until UpSnap reports the result. When `false`, UpSnap runs the action in the background and the action returns at once. Defaults to `true`.
